# Visor Development Kit

> The Visor Development Kit (VDK) lets Android apps, programs on a computer and web apps on the Display use
> Ray-Ban Meta glasses, the Meta Ray-Ban Display and the Meta Neural Band through Visor, the Android app that runs
> them. It is an alternative to
> Meta's Wearables Device Access Toolkit (DAT), with no Meta AI app, Meta account or developer review.

## Docs

- [Overview](overview.md): what the VDK is, how it reaches the glasses, and the roadmap.
- [Getting started](getting-started.md): an Android app from nothing to a photo taken with the glasses.
- [Scopes and consent](scopes-and-consent.md): what the person allows, and how an app asks.
- [The connection](connection.md): one Visor object, its states and its restarts.
- [Glasses](glasses.md): status, pairs, touches and presses, and motion.
- [Camera and captures](camera-and-captures.md): photos, videos, the live camera and imports.
- [Display](display.md): the teleprompter, layouts and Briefing cards on the Meta Ray-Ban Display.
- [Briefing cards](briefing-cards.md): cards on the Display's home with details, pages, charts and clicks, with recipes.
- [Web apps on the Display](web-apps.md): the VDK from JavaScript in a web app on the Display, with Visor.connectGlasses.
- [Neural Band](neural-band.md): gestures, wrist motion, vibration, and sharing the band with the phone.
- [Voice and the assistant](voice-and-assistant.md): questions that name the app, starting it by voice, transcripts, tools for the model.
- [Settings](settings.md): the glasses' settings.
- [Errors](errors.md): KitException codes and reasons.
- [Testing](testing.md): the visor command, FakeVisor, visor fake and the Display simulator.
- [JSON-RPC](json-rpc.md): the protocol, for any language.
- [The network door](network.md): JSON-RPC and MCP over the network.
- [Compatibility](compatibility.md): how apps and Visor stay compatible across versions.
- [Porting from DAT](porting-from-dat.md): each part of Meta's DAT and its VDK equivalent.
- [AI tools](ai-tools.md): the docs search, its MCP server, and guidance for coding assistants.

## Optional

- [Guidance for coding assistants](for-agents.md): rules for code that uses the VDK, to save as AGENTS.md.
